sources.entry: Wizarr | User invitation and onboarding for Jellyfin, Plex and Emby

summary.one_liner: Wizarr is an automatic user invitation and management system for media servers such as Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Audiobookshelf, Romm, Komga and Kavita.
summary.what_it_does: Wizarr generates unique invite links that you share with friends or family. Recipients are automatically added to the configured media server and guided through setup steps such as downloading apps and accessing request systems. It supports automatic invitations for Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Audiobookshelf, Komga, Kavita and Romm. Features listed include multi-tiered invitation access, time-limited memberships, pre-invite and post-invite wizard steps, and a setup guide for media apps. It also offers request system integration (Seerr, Ombi, etc.), Discord invite support, and customisable HTML snippets. The README also mentions a REST API with automatic OpenAPI/Swagger documentation.
use_cases: invite friends to a Plex server
onboard new Jellyfin or Emby users
share media server access via a link
guide new users through installing media apps
automate user management for home media servers
how_to_run: See the project documentation for installation and running instructions (the README links to docs but does not include commands).
stack: Python-based REST API (per OpenAPI/Swagger docs; language not explicitly named in README)
notable: Automatic invite-to-account creation across multiple media servers (Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Audiobookshelf, Komga, Kavita, Romm)
Pre-invite and post-invite wizard steps that guide new users through setup
Multi-tiered invitation access and time-limited memberships
Plug-and-play SSO support (marked with an asterisk in the README)
caveats: Installation details are in external documentation rather than the README
SSO support is marked with an asterisk, and the README does not explain the caveat
